title: agentgw ledger entry
description: One line of the JSONL ledger (docs/adr/0004): one tool call, whatever its outcome. Lines are written as RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON, UTF-8, no trailing whitespace, newline-terminated. Hashing rules: line_hash = SHA-256 of the line bytes without the newline; prev_hash = line_hash of the previous line of any type (entry or checkpoint), or 64 zeros for the first line; args_hash = SHA-256 of JCS(raw args object); result_hash = SHA-256 of JCS(raw CallToolResult with the protocol envelope removed), empty string when nothing was forwarded. Protocol envelope (docs/adr/0008): the top-level `resultType` member and every `_meta` member whose key starts with `io.modelcontextprotocol/`; when that empties `_meta`, `_meta` itself is removed. Nothing else is removed (`_meta.cost` and other vendor keys stay). The proxy forwards results to the client untouched; only the ledger strips; sig = Ed25519 over JCS(entry with the 'sig' member removed). Stored args and result.content are the redacted copies; hashes always cover the raw payloads. Version 1 (rev 9, gap-007: optional decision.approval.via; rev 5, gap-004: optional action.input_responses, input_responses_hash, request_state).

id.description: Entry id, assigned by Ledger.Append. Monotonic within one ledger file.

ts.description: UTC RFC 3339 with nanoseconds, when the entry was appended.

call_id.description: Gateway call id, assigned by the proxy before any stage runs. Ties this entry to approvals and to the _meta.agentgw payload the client saw.

input_responses.description: Redacted copy of tools/call params.inputResponses on a multi-round-trip retry. Absent (not null) when the call had none; then input_responses_hash and request_state are absent too.

input_responses_hash.description: SHA-256 of JCS(raw inputResponses). args_hash stays over arguments only.

request_state.description: params.requestState verbatim (opaque server state the client echoed).

decision.description: The policy decision for this call, plus the human decision when one was requested.

grant_id.description: Grant that satisfied a require_approval rule, or empty.

approval.description: Null unless outcome was require_approval and a human decided. Timeout leaves it null.

outcome.description: What happened to the call. ok: forwarded and upstream answered (including a tool-level isError result). error: forwarding failed (transport or JSON-RPC error); reservation released.

content.description: Redacted copy of the upstream CallToolResult with the protocol envelope removed, or null when nothing was forwarded.

result_hash.description: Empty exactly when content is null.

error.description: Non-ok outcomes: for refusals, exactly CallError.Error() (reason formats fixed in pkg/contracts/errors.go); for outcome error, the Forward error text. Empty when ok.

actual.description: What was settled. Zero when the call was not forwarded or the reservation was released.
